title: Hollow Drifter
description: A detuned supersaw lead that drifts up through the full register while a slow filter journey opens from sub-bass murk to glassy highs. Layered jux/off detune copies and a cycling vowel give it a hollow, breathing alien vocal character that never settles.
code:
setcpm(110/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 g3 eb4 [bb4 f5] c3 g4>/2").s("supersaw")
    .detune(sine.slow(19).range(0.1, 0.9)).unison(5)
    .vowel("<a o u e>/3")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(120, 7000)).resonance(sine.slow(24).range(6, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.25)
    .phaser(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 1.1)).phaserdepth(0.7)
    .attack(0.02).decay(0.3).sustain(0.6).release(0.2)
    .shape(0.25)
    .jux(rev)
    .off(0.02, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.4).pan(0.7))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.6).gain(0.8)
)
